claims.object_text: PNKP activity is abrogated in ATXN3-depleted or pathogenic ATXN3-expressing cells
claims.quote: ATXN3-depleted or pathogenic ATXN3-expressing cells abrogate polynucleotide kinase 3'-phosphatase (PNKP) activity.

claims.object_text: PNKP is among C-NHEJ proteins that associate with RNAP II and nascent RNAs
claims.quote: ATXN3 associates with RNA polymerase II (RNAP II) and the classical nonhomologous end-joining (C-NHEJ) proteins, including PNKP, along with nascent RNAs under physiological conditions.

claims.object_text: PNKP-mediated error-free C-NHEJ of transcribed genes
reduced PNKP activity in SCA3 brain extracts
claims.quote: brain extracts from SCA3 patients and mice show significantly lower PNKP activity

claims.object_text: Drosophila SCA3 model amenable to PNKP complementation
claims.quote: SCA3 phenotype in Drosophila was completely amenable to PNKP complementation.

claims.object_text: salvaging PNKP activity as a therapeutic strategy for SCA3
claims.quote: Hence, salvaging PNKP's activity can be a promising therapeutic strategy for SCA3.
